title: 异步编程基础
subtitle: 了解asyncio和协程

blocks.text: 异步编程允许程序在等待I/O操作时执行其他任务，提高效率。Python使用asyncio库实现异步编程。

blocks.code:
import asyncio

async def hello():
    print('Hello')
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
    print('World')

asyncio.run(hello())

blocks.question: async/await的作用是什么？
blocks.explain: async定义异步函数，await等待异步操作完成

blocks.title: 练习：异步延时
blocks.code:
import asyncio

async def delayed_print(msg, delay):
    print(f'等待{delay}秒...')
    await asyncio.sleep(delay)
    print(msg)

asyncio.run(delayed_print('完成!', 2))

blocks.text: 异步函数不能直接调用，需要使用asyncio.run()

blocks.title: 项目：异步任务管理器
blocks.code:
import asyncio

async def download(url, time):
    print(f'开始下载{url}')
    await asyncio.sleep(time)
    print(f'完成下载{url}')
    return f'{url}完成'

async def main():
    tasks = [
        download('file1.zip', 2),
        download('file2.zip', 3),
        download('file3.zip', 1)
    ]
    results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    print(f'所有任务: {results}')

asyncio.run(main())
blocks.goal: 创建异步下载管理器，并行执行多个下载任务
blocks.hint: asyncio.gather()可以并行执行多个协程

tests: asyncio.gather should run tasks in parallel
hint: async def 定义协程，await等待异步操作

title: 异步IO操作
subtitle: 学习异步文件和网络操作

blocks.text: 使用aiofiles库可以进行异步文件操作，避免阻塞主线程。

blocks.code:
import asyncio
import aiofiles

async def async_read(filename):
    async with aiofiles.open(filename, 'r') as f:
        content = await f.read()
    return content

# 注意：需要安装aiofiles: pip install aiofiles

blocks.question: 为什么需要异步文件操作？
blocks.explain: 异步文件操作避免在读写时阻塞主线程，提高并发性能

blocks.title: 练习：异步写入
blocks.code:
import asyncio
import aiofiles

async def async_write(filename, content):
    async with aiofiles.open(filename, 'w') as f:
        await f.write(content)
    print(f'已写入{filename}')

asyncio.run(async_write('test.txt', '异步写入测试'))
blocks.hint: async with aiofiles.open()异步打开文件

blocks.text: aiofiles需要单独安装: pip install aiofiles

blocks.title: 项目：异步文件处理器
blocks.code:
import asyncio
import aiofiles

async def process_file(input_file, output_file):
    async with aiofiles.open(input_file, 'r') as f:
        content = await f.read()
    
    processed = content.upper()
    
    async with aiofiles.open(output_file, 'w') as f:
        await f.write(processed)
    print(f'处理完成: {output_file}')

asyncio.run(process_file('input.txt', 'output.txt'))
blocks.goal: 创建异步文件处理器，读取文件并转换为大写后写入新文件
blocks.hint: 使用aiofiles进行异步读写操作

tests: aiofiles should be used for async operations
file content should be processed correctly
hint: 使用aiofiles进行异步文件操作，需要pip install aiofiles
